episode_title: Who Are You Without Your Job Title? Reinventing Yourself in Midlife with Marianne DeMello-Smith

real_qa.q: What did Marianne DeMello-Smith do after leaving her 25-year corporate career?
real_qa.r: Marianne created Message in the Middle, a podcast and community with real stories and hard-won lessons that help people find balance, meaning, and connection. She believes her messes often hold the keys to our greater messages.
real_qa.requete: Marianne DeMello-Smith Message in the Middle podcast

real_qa.q: Why did Marianne DeMello-Smith leave her corporate job after 25 years?
real_qa.r: The company she grew up in was acquired twice in a couple of years, becoming completely different. By the time she separated, she was not aligned anymore with the organization, and there was a mutual feeling of not being in alignment.

real_qa.q: What is the I Don't Care Club movement mentioned in midlife conversations?
real_qa.r: A viral social media movement started by a woman who created videos about midlife women embracing freedom from external expectations—going to places like Whole Foods without makeup or a bra because she doesn't care. It has become such an impact that there are now meetups and branches of the club across different regions, including New England.
real_qa.requete: I Don't Care Club midlife women viral

real_qa.q: What does the Red Hat Society and When I'm an Old Woman I Shall Wear Purple represent?
real_qa.r: These represent movements that celebrate women in their later years and midlife. The Red Hat Society was mentioned in the book When I'm an Old Woman I Shall Wear Purple, a collection of writing and photographs evoking the beauty, humor, and courage of women living in their later years, showing endearing moments of joy and passion in midlife and beyond.
real_qa.requete: When I'm an Old Woman Shall Wear Purple Red Hat Society

real_qa.q: What is the concept of 'fast pass' or 'easy pass' in midlife mentoring?
real_qa.r: Sharing messes, lessons, triumphs and struggles gives somebody else a fast pass to the same scenario. By sharing real experiences, mentors can help younger people avoid some of the stumbles they experienced, making it a little bit easier for the next generation navigating similar challenges.
